stdout:
## Five Whys  [deep]
Ask why five times, each answer becoming the next question

## Yes And Building  [creative]
Never negate; each person opens with "Yes, and..." and adds to the last idea, stacking a chain

Accept every offer before judging it. Say "Yes, and" out loud if it helps.

Then build: each addition must use what the last person left.

## Random Word  [wild]
A random word becomes the seed; force a connection → then follow it
